description: Paid x402 tool. Get governed public relationships for one master-data golden record, such as supplier ownership, location hierarchy, or organization parentage. Returns direction, validity dates, provenance, and confidence. Price IDs by requested depth: price.relationships.depth-1.v1, price.relationships.depth-2.v1, or price.relationships.depth-3.v1.

entityType.description: One of the v1 entity domains. customer, asset, and person are closed Operator decisions, not gaps; reference data is served by get_reference_data.

inputSchema.description: Input for the paid fetch of the relationship graph around one golden record, priced by traversal depth. Mirrors GET /v1/master-data/entities/{entity_type}/{record_id}/relationships.

depth.description: Traversal depth. Each depth is a separately priced tier.

record_id.description: Golden-record identifier within the entity domain.

inputSchema.title: get_master_data_relationships tool input

name: get_master_data_relationships
title: Get Master Data Relationships
